name: Ueno (Mie, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ueno city emblem in red: an outlined lobed device enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former city of Ueno in Mie Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in September 1905.

features.role: Ueno city emblem — an outlined lobed device enclosing a stylised character
